Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses Technical specification of Transcriptome analysis Total No of Samples: 24 Technical Specifications: 1. Isolate high-quality, NGS-grade total RNA from the supplied plants samples and assess RNA conce ntration, purity, integrity, and contamination. Provide quality control (QC) reports for all samples. 2. The bidder shall collect the all 24 plant tissue samples from ICAR-IIWBR, Karn al, using appropriate procedures for RNA preservation and transport, at no add itional cost. 3. Ensure RNA meets established sequencing quality standards, preferably with RIN ≥ 8.0, A260/A28 0 ratio of 1.8–2.1, and A260/A230 ratio of ≥ 2.0. Return unused RNA/cDNA for confirmation and do wnstream analysis. 4. Prepare high-quality sequencing libraries using an appropriate library preparation protocol suited strictly to wheat plant sample type 5. Perform high-throughput sequencing using an Illumina platform or equivalent, with paired-end 15 0 bp (2 × 150 bp) reads. 6. Generate at least 30 million clean read pairs per sample, with ≥ 85% of bases at Q30 or higher, a nd provide raw sequencing data in FASTQ format. 7. Perform adapter removal, quality filtering, and read quality assessment using a standardized, doc umented pipeline. Provide raw and processed FASTQ files with corresponding QC reports. 8. Perform reference-based read alignment and/or transcriptome assembly, gene expression quantif ication, and coding sequence (CDS) prediction etc. · Conduct functional annotation and pathway analysis using relevant databases, including NCBI NR, Gene Ontology (GO), and KEGG etc. · Perform differential gene expression analysis to identify significantly upregulated and downregula ted genes, supported by statistical results. Provide gene expression tables, GO classification plots, heatmaps, volcano plots, and other relevant visualizations etc. · Provide a comprehensive final analysis report, raw and processed sequencing data, QC reports, a nnotation results, and relevant analysis files. Assist with deposition of sequencing data in an appro priate public repository. · The bidder must have an in-house sequencing platform equivalent to or higher in capacity than th e Illumina NovaSeq 6000. The platform must have been installed and operational for at least five y ears. Submit the manufacturer-issued installation certificate for the sequencing platform. Provide t he latest instrument maintenance and calibration certificates. Also have a dedicated in-house bioin formatics facility and provide details of the qualified bioinformatics personnel and team compositio n. · Demonstrate successful completion of at least five similar RNA-seq or whole-transcriptome seque ncing projects for ICAR, DBT, DST, or recognized academic/research institutions etc. Submit suppor ting work orders and project completion certificates or equivalent documentary evidence. Submit c opies of previous purchase orders (POs) for similar or related work. Provide the names and contact details, including email addresses and phone numbers, of at least five previous clients or research ers for whom similar work has been completed.

· Ensure that all sequencing and analysis data are generated exclusively from the Institute's sampl es under the contracted project. Provide raw sequencing-run records and QC reports for verificatio n of data authenticity and sample traceability whenever requested by the Institute. · RNA isolation, library preparation, sequencing, and bioinformatics activities must be performed e ntirely within India. No sample, sequence, or project data shall be transferred or processed outside India. Maintain applicable laboratory quality certifications/accreditations and statutory registrations etc. Submit relevant documentary evidence of such certifications and registrations. Submit a self-d eclaration confirming that the bidder has not been blacklisted or debarred by any Government dep artment, ICAR institute, or funding/research agency. The specification is generic in nature. . 5. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer uploaded ATC document Click here to view the file.
